shutdown.low_current_model_boundary: Below0.1uA and reverse behavior are unmeasured linear extension. Shutdown result is numerical electrical diagnostic, not leakage/optical-darkness qualification.
shutdown.displacement_definition: 200fF * native-grid nonuniform central derivative of LED A-K voltage; peak is numerical approximation, charge uses exact endpoint C*deltaV.

recovery_screen.definition: Last post-release amplitude/timing failure plus one line UI at the frozen first-frame training phase; all later sampled bits through end-minus8UI satisfy the normal margins. Finite-trace settling diagnostic, not synchronization protocol.
